events.name: Bash
events.head: Check b-pass wording in generator and hub
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "b-pass" workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py | head; grep -c "Two-Month Platform Pass" workshop-plan/index.html; grep -n -i "1 month\|worth \$99" workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py workshop-plan/index.html | head; git status --short workshop-plan/index.html workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Regenerate hub and compare
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -o '"b-pass","[^"]*","[^"]*"' workshop-plan/index.html; grep -o -i '1 month, worth[^"<]*' workshop-plan/index.html | head -3; cp workshop-plan/index.html /tmp/t144_before.html; python3 workshop-plan/build/review_hub.py 2>&1 | tail -4; cmp -s /tmp/t144_before.html workshop-plan/index.html && echo UNCHANGED || git diff --stat workshop-plan/index.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect regen diff and b-pass node
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff workshop-plan/index.html | cut -c1-300 | grep '^[-+]' | head; diff <(tr ',' '\n' < /tmp/t144_before.html) <(tr ',' '\n' < workshop-plan/index.html) | head -20; grep -o '.\{20\}"b-pass".\{150\}' workshop-plan/index.html | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restore hub, check live clone, run probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cp /tmp/t144_before.html workshop-plan/index.html; git status --short workshop-plan/index.html; git -C live status --short 2>/dev/null | head -3; git check-ignore live && echo live-ignored; (cd app && timeout 300 node scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check live clone diff and run probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git -C live diff --stat | tail -2; cd app && node scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5

events.text: Probe passes. Restoring the generator's file-list-only change in the live clone, then logging the task.
